verdict.rationale: Jira is an issue-tracking and project-management product. Requiring AI-authored commits to be signed with SSH or GPG keys is a source-control or coding-agent concern, so the story is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Jira or Rovo AI authoring or signing commits; the Bitbucket integration and the 'view development status' feature only surface development status inside Jira.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
